chapter.verse: Topa aw, ka thungetna hong za in la, ka thuumnate hong ngai in! Na thumanna leh na thutakna tawh kizui-in kei hong dawng in!
Na nasempa, thu hong sit kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangma mai-ah mihing a dik kuamah om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gal in kei hong bawlsia a, hong zogawp hi; sau veipi-a a site bangin a mial sungah hong tusak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka cih nading ka thei nawn kei a, ka lungtang-ah si teeng lo hi.
Hunluite ka phawk a, nangma sepsate khempeuh ka ngaihsunsun hi; na khut in a sepsa nate ka lungngaingai hi.
Thu ngenin nang lamah ka khut kong zan a, leikeu in tui a duh bangin nang kong duh hi.
Topa aw, kei hong dawng mengmeng in! Kei ka cimawh ta hi! Leihawm sung misite kiang-a paisukte tawh ka kibat loh nadingin kei kiang panin na maitang seel kei in.
Nangmah hong muang ka hih manin na itna kip zingsangin kei hong zasak in. Nangma tungah thu hong ngen ka hih manin, ka pai nading lampi hong hilh in.
Topa aw, ka langte’ kiang panin kei hong honkhia in! Nangmah beel dingin kong tai hi!
Nang in keima Pasian na hih manin nangma deih banga gamta dingin kei hong hilh in! Kei hong hehpih in la, lamphei-ah hong kha in.
Topa aw, nangma min na ngaihsutna-in keima nuntakna hong kem in! Nangma thumanna tawh kituakin haksatna panin kei hong paikhiatpih in!
Kei pen nangma nasem ka hih manin na itna kip tawh kituakin ka galte khenkhia in la, ka langte khempeuh susia in.
